audit.why: Taliyah-favored in every phase per packet and content: Veigar has no waveclear, no mobility, and depends on Baleful Strike stacks she can deny; his only kill route is the Event Horizon cage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full chart said Taliyah x3 / Skill / Skill / Veigar / Veigar while content win[] and packet both say Taliyah on all seven rows.
audit.why: Content whys are kit-grounded (stack denial, pre-stack R doesn't one-shot, immobile target, cage is his only late threat). Full sides on rows 3-6 moved to Taliyah with rewritten whys.
audit.corrected: All seven full sides now Taliyah.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldowns field had no digits; two pasted trade strings under Do's/Don'ts titles; a typo in spikes[3].text ('a angle').
audit.why: Event Horizon is 20s at rank 1 (14s max) and only its edge stuns; Primordial Burst runs 120/90/60s. Taliyah must never W or dash herself onto the cage edge — her own displacement can stun her side of the fight.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns rewritten with digits and the free-window framing; bleed bullets rewritten to match titles; typo fixed.

edits.before: Veigar wins by landing Event Horizon (Cage), denying your pattern, and keeping the fight at a distance your kit resents.
edits.after: Veigar wins by farming stacks uncontested, then landing Event Horizon into W and R for a one-shot you never get to answer.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q-poke on every wave contact. Fresh-ground positioning is your real skill expression now.
edits.after: Superior waveclear starves his Baleful Strike stacks through 4-5 — an under-farmed Veigar has no trade to threaten you.

edits.before: Weaver's Wall online — you are now the best roaming mid in the game. Every shove is a bot-lane gank announcement.
edits.after: His R execute won't one-shot pre-stacks — stay above the threshold, keep shoving, and out-roam him with Weaver's Wall.

edits.before: Luden's spike: the W-E-Q rotation deletes squishies. Force river fights where your stones pre-seed the geometry.
edits.after: Luden's clear pins an immobile, stack-starved Veigar under tower — crash and roam before his scaling ever comes online.

edits.before: Late Taliyah edits maps: wall their reinforcements, shove their frontline into your team, and Q whatever stands on stones.
edits.after: Stacked Veigar one-shots only through Event Horizon — never dash or W yourself onto the cage edge and you keep the edge.

edits.before: - Veigar Event Horizon (Cage): matchup-defining — Only the cage EDGE stuns — hold position near the center or leave before it forms; never dash into the wall. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Seismic Shove for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Event Horizon (20s rank 1, 14s max): only the cage EDGE stuns — hold near the center or leave before it forms; never dash into the wall. A wasted cage is a 14-20s free window. - Primordial Burst runs 120/90/60s. - Your W (14s) is for emergencies, R for chances.

edits.before: Q from fresh ground on his last-hit, and if he steps to answer, W-shove him across the E-field — the full geometry trade is half a health bar.
edits.after: Seed Q stones across the lane's center before trading — worked-ground boulders slow him, and a slowed Veigar with no dash can't escape your W-E root.

edits.before: Trading while standing on your own Worked Ground — one-stone Qs lose every exchange your positioning already conceded.
edits.after: Your Q casts on the move — use it; a stationary Taliyah is the easy Dark Matter and cage target his burst is built around.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport or Ignite — TP doubles the roam thesis; Ignite converts the W-E burst into early deletions. Pick by how hard you intend to roam.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport or Ignite — TP feeds the roam plan against an immobile laner; Ignite finishes what the W-E root starts. Pick by intent.

edits.before: This is the danger window: fully stacked Veigar one-shots if his Event Horizon cage lands. Never walk into the cage, flank with Weaver's Wall, and burst him with W-E from a angle he can't stun.
edits.after: This is the danger window: fully stacked Veigar one-shots if his Event Horizon cage lands. Never walk into the cage, flank with Weaver's Wall, and burst him with W-E from an angle he can't stun.
